Communal violence in Nepal leads to heightened security on Bihar border

Communal clashes erupted in Nepal's Sunsari district, leading to curfews and prohibitory orders in several towns. Security has been heightened along the India-Nepal border in Bihar's Madhubani and other districts due to fears of spillover. Nepali Prime Minister Balen Shah appealed for unity and restraint. The violence has prompted surveillance and search operations by Bihar Police.
